description: Use when the user asks whether a coin is unusually quiet. For a squeeze use get_compression_alert (local package). Ex: symbol=ETH&period=14d Free trial: 10 calls a day. More tools (30, paid per call in USDC via x402): run the local server, `uvx swaphunt-mcp`, https://x402.swaphunt.dev/docs
